question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**coach**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage is 'The sign and symbols of Railways'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is 'coach'.
 
• The given passage is about a train & every train has coaches attached to it. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *There is always something so fascinating about trains and journeys. There are certain symbols and signages inside and outside of the train. The meanings of most of them might not be known to everyone. Whether you are a frequent traveller or not, you may have noticed the letter X or a cross mark on the back of the last **coach** of the train.*
